ranking.explanation: Keep the earliest feasible arrival. At the same arrival, prefer complete footprints with the largest smallest threshold margin (hours). Break ties by darkness, Earth-gap, and joint-time margins, then center metrics and site ID. All components remain visible; this is a declared preference, not a universal optimum.

search.interpretation: Discrete search over cached samples. Earliest is relative to the chosen grid and data coverage; no missing interval is treated as feasible.
search.candidateSelection: First three feasible candidates under the declared search ranking. Full earliestFeasible and Pareto sets are retained.
